Thanks for the update, Monica / Jordan. Quick legal note before we rebook:

- Section 5 (data residency): Redwood's proposed language narrows the residency requirement to customer data at-rest for regulated records — we can present the rationale (operational feasibility + encryption controls) in the call.
- Retention: we added a 30/90/365 table with a recommended default; happy to discuss exceptions for regulated data classes.
- Indemnity: we've maintained mutual carve-outs and added a $1M cap tied to gross negligence; if Novus has a different cap in mind, please flag.
- SLA: updated uptime and SLO credits are in the table; Marcus can speak to availability patterns and fallback routing.

If Novus wants to prioritize a subset, suggest the order: 1) Data residency, 2) SLA credits, 3) Indemnity. That will keep the session focused and we can follow up with proposed legal language for the remaining items.

I'll join whichever slot you confirm; Marcus will handle the SLA walk.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Legal, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0142
